facts.business: Allcargo Terminals Limited operates as one of India's leading Container Freight Station (CFS) operators, providing container transportation and handling services.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Three-year strategic growth plan with expansion agenda

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to management incentives
Cybersecurity threats and data privacy risks
Dependence on key contracts like Speedy CFS with JNPA
facts.related_party_note: Preferential issue of 63,64,800 equity shares to CEO Ashish Chandna at INR 42.4 per share for acquisition of 15% stake in Speedy Multimodes Limited valued at INR 66.3 per share; Promoter holding increased from 65.82% to 67.52%
